decisions.title: Use Dafny for core logic
decisions.context: Core scheduling logic must be provably correct.
decisions.decision: Implement core modules in Dafny with Z3 verification.
decisions.consequences: Higher upfront cost but strong correctness guarantees.

decisions.title: HTTP API as io-shell
decisions.context: Need to expose scheduler to external clients.
decisions.decision: Use ASP.NET Core for HTTP API shell.
decisions.consequences: Unverified I/O layer but thin and delegates to verified core.

openRisks.mitigation: Limit DAG size and use efficient algorithms.
openRisks.description: Dafny verification may be slow for large DAGs.

openRisks.mitigation: Use idempotent job assignments and status updates.
openRisks.description: Distributed consistency between orchestrator and workers.

components.name: ScheduleContracts
components.internals: Pure Dafny datatypes and predicates. No I/O. Used by all other modules.

testCases.name: JobId equality
testCases.description: Two JobIds with same value are equal.

testCases.name: CronExpression valid
testCases.description: A cron expression with 5 fields is valid.

testCases.name: DagNode dependencies
testCases.description: A DAG node with a dependency on another node is valid.

components.responsibility: Defines core datatypes and contracts for jobs, cron expressions, DAG nodes, worker status, and retry policy.

components.name: CronParser
components.internals: Pure Dafny parsing and validation. Uses ScheduleContracts datatypes.

testCases.name: Parse valid cron
testCases.description: Parse '0 0 * * *' returns five fields.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ParseCron returns CronFields with five fields and Valid() true

testCases.name: Reject invalid cron
testCases.description: Parse '0 0 * *' returns failure.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ParseCron returns failure due to insufficient fields

components.responsibility: Parses cron expressions into structured fields and validates them.

components.name: DagEngine
components.internals: Pure Dafny graph algorithms. Uses ScheduleContracts DagNode.

testCases.name: Valid DAG
testCases.description: A DAG with no cycles is valid.

testCases.name: Cycle detection
testCases.description: A DAG with a cycle is invalid.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ValidateDag returns false and HasCycle returns true

components.responsibility: Validates DAG structure, detects cycles, and computes topological order for job dependencies.

components.name: SchedulerCore
components.internals: Pure Dafny state machine over job queue and status. Uses ScheduleContracts and DagEngine.

testCases.name: Enqueue job
testCases.description: Enqueue a job with no dependencies makes it Ready.

testCases.name: Dequeue ready job
testCases.description: DequeueReadyJob returns a Ready job and marks it Running.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns job and status becomes Running

testCases.name: Dependency blocks job
testCases.description: A job with an unfinished dependency is not Ready.

components.responsibility: Maintains job queue, schedules jobs based on cron and DAG readiness, and tracks job status.

components.name: RetryPolicy
components.internals: Pure Dafny arithmetic and policy logic. Uses ScheduleContracts RetryPolicy.

testCases.name: Backoff doubles
testCases.description: ComputeBackoff(2) returns 4x base delay.

testCases.name: Max retries
testCases.description: ShouldRetry(5) returns false.

components.responsibility: Computes retry delays with exponential backoff and determines when a job moves to the dead letter queue.

components.name: WorkerPool
components.internals: Pure Dafny worker pool state. Uses ScheduleContracts WorkerStatus.

testCases.name: Register worker
testCases.description: Register a worker makes it available.

testCases.name: Assign job
testCases.description: Assigning a job to an available worker marks it busy.

components.responsibility: Manages worker registration, availability, and assignment of jobs to workers.

components.name: DeadLetterQueue
components.internals: Pure Dafny queue of failed jobs. Uses ScheduleContracts Job.

testCases.name: Add job
testCases.description: Adding a job makes it retrievable.

testCases.name: Remove job
testCases.description: Removing a job removes it from retrieval.
testCases.expectedBehavior: GetDeadLetterJobs no longer contains the job

components.responsibility: Stores jobs that have exhausted retries and provides retrieval for inspection.

components.name: StatusTracker
components.internals: Pure Dafny status history store. Uses ScheduleContracts JobStatus.

testCases.name: Record transition
testCases.description: Recording a transition updates current status.

testCases.name: History order
testCases.description: History preserves insertion order.

components.responsibility: Records job status transitions and provides queryable history.

components.name: SchedulerOrchestrator
components.internals: Pure Dafny orchestration logic. Uses all core modules.

testCases.name: Submit job
testCases.description: Submitting a valid job schedules it.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Job is queued and status is Pending

testCases.name: Run scheduler
testCases.description: Running the scheduler assigns ready jobs to workers.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Ready jobs are assigned to available workers

components.responsibility: Coordinates scheduler core, worker pool, retry policy, dead letter queue, and status tracker to execute jobs.

components.name: SchedulerApi
components.internals: ASP.NET Core web API shell. Delegates to SchedulerOrchestrator.

testCases.name: Submit job endpoint
testCases.description: POST /jobs returns 202 Accepted.

testCases.name: Get status endpoint
testCases.description: GET /jobs/{id} returns current status.

components.responsibility: Exposes HTTP endpoints for submitting jobs, querying status, and managing workers.

dataStores.name: JobStore
dataStores.schema: JobId, CronExpression, Dependencies, Status, RetryCount, CreatedAt

interfaces.name: SchedulerHttpApi
interfaces.schemaRef: Job submission and status query JSON

systemContext: A distributed task scheduler that accepts cron expressions and DAG-based job dependencies, manages a pool of workers, retries failed jobs with exponential backoff, routes permanently failed jobs to a dead letter queue, and tracks job status throughout the lifecycle.

qualityAttributes.rationale: Distributed scheduler must be available for critical jobs.
Jobs must be tracked through all states.

deploymentTopology: Single orchestrator node with multiple worker nodes. Orchestrator exposes HTTP API and manages queues. Workers poll for assignments.
